captureMode: read-only public documentation; official gallery thumbnail assets

entries.title: Anscombe’s quartet
entries.label: lmplot
entries.role: Fit a regression model while retaining observations and faceting options.

entries.title: Scatterplot with multiple semantics
entries.label: scatterplot
entries.role: One point per observation; map more variables to visual semantics.
entries.call:
sns.scatterplot(x="carat", y="price",
                hue="clarity", size="depth",
                palette="ch:r=-.2,d=.3_r",
                hue_order=clarity_ranking,
                sizes=(1, 8), linewidth=0,
                data=diamonds, ax=ax)

entries.title: Timeseries plot with error bands
entries.label: lineplot
entries.role: Connect ordered observations; use grouping and error bands to show continuity.
entries.call:
sns.lineplot(x="timepoint", y="signal",
             hue="region", style="event",
             data=fmri)

entries.title: Facetting histograms by subsets of data
entries.label: displot
entries.role: Figure-level distribution interface: switch among histogram, KDE, ECDF and rug views.
entries.call:
sns.displot(
    df, x="flipper_length_mm", col="species", row="sex",
    binwidth=3, height=3, facet_kws=dict(margin_titles=True),
)

entries.title: Line plots on multiple facets
entries.label: relplot
entries.role: Figure-level relational interface: switch between relational kinds and facet them.
entries.call:
sns.relplot(
    data=dots,
    x="time", y="firing_rate",
    hue="coherence", size="choice", col="align",
    kind="line", size_order=["T1", "T2"], palette=palette,
    height=5, aspect=.75, facet_kws=dict(sharex=False),
)

entries.title: Grouped barplots
entries.label: catplot
entries.role: Figure-level categorical interface with switchable plot kinds and facets.
entries.call:
g = sns.catplot(
    data=penguins, kind="bar",
    x="species", y="body_mass_g", hue="sex",
    errorbar="sd", palette="dark", alpha=.6, height=6
)

entries.title: Grouped boxplots
entries.label: boxplot
entries.role: Compare categorical distributions through quartiles and potential outliers.
entries.call:
sns.boxplot(x="day", y="total_bill",
            hue="smoker", palette=["m", "g"],
            data=tips)

entries.title: Grouped violinplots with split violins
entries.label: violinplot
entries.role: Combine a distribution shape with categorical comparison and inner summaries.
entries.call:
sns.violinplot(data=tips, x="day", y="total_bill", hue="smoker",
               split=True, inner="quart", fill=False,
               palette={"Yes": "g", "No": ".35"})

entries.title: Scatterplot heatmap
entries.label: relplot
entries.role: Figure-level relational interface: switch between relational kinds and facet them.
entries.call:
g = sns.relplot(
    data=corr_mat,
    x="level_0", y="level_1", hue="correlation", size="correlation",
    palette="vlag", hue_norm=(-1, 1), edgecolor=".7",
    height=10, sizes=(50, 250), size_norm=(-.2, .8),
)

entries.title: Hexbin plot with marginal distributions
entries.label: jointplot
entries.role: Convenient joint-and-marginal view with a switchable bivariate kind.
entries.call: sns.jointplot(x=x, y=y, kind="hex", color="#4CB391")

entries.title: Stacked histogram on a log scale
entries.label: histplot
entries.role: Count or normalise observations inside bins; compare groups with hue and elements.
entries.call:
sns.histplot(
    diamonds,
    x="price", hue="cut",
    multiple="stack",
    palette="light:m_r",
    edgecolor=".3",
    linewidth=.5,
    log_scale=True,
)

entries.title: Horizontal boxplot with observations
entries.label: boxplot
entries.role: Compare categorical distributions through quartiles and potential outliers.
entries.call:
sns.boxplot(
    planets, x="distance", y="method", hue="method",
    whis=[0, 100], width=.6, palette="vlag"
)

entries.title: Conditional means with observations
entries.label: stripplot
entries.role: Show individual observations across categories, with jitter for overlap.
entries.call:
sns.stripplot(
    data=iris, x="value", y="measurement", hue="species",
    dodge=True, alpha=.25, zorder=1, legend=False,
)

entries.title: Joint and marginal histograms
entries.label: JointGrid
entries.role: Combine a bivariate view with marginal views on the same figure.
entries.call: g = sns.JointGrid(data=planets, x="year", y="distance", marginal_ticks=True)

entries.title: Joint kernel density estimate
entries.label: jointplot
entries.role: Convenient joint-and-marginal view with a switchable bivariate kind.
entries.call:
g = sns.jointplot(
    data=penguins,
    x="bill_length_mm", y="bill_depth_mm", hue="species",
    kind="kde",
)

entries.title: Overlapping densities (‘ridge plot’)
entries.label: FacetGrid
entries.role: Build a grid of subsets and map a plotting function into each facet.
entries.call: g = sns.FacetGrid(df, row="g", hue="g", aspect=15, height=.5, palette=pal)

entries.title: Plotting large distributions
entries.label: boxenplot
entries.role: Show distribution summaries for larger datasets with more quantile detail.
entries.call:
sns.boxenplot(
    diamonds, x="clarity", y="carat",
    color="b", order=clarity_ranking, width_method="linear",
)

entries.title: Bivariate plot with multiple elements
entries.label: scatterplot
entries.role: One point per observation; map more variables to visual semantics.
entries.call: sns.scatterplot(x=x, y=y, s=5, color=".15")

entries.title: Faceted logistic regression
entries.label: lmplot
entries.role: Fit a regression model while retaining observations and faceting options.
entries.call:
g = sns.lmplot(x="age", y="survived", col="sex", hue="sex", data=df,
               palette=pal, y_jitter=.02, logistic=True, truncate=False)

entries.title: Plotting on a large number of facets
entries.label: FacetGrid
entries.role: Build a grid of subsets and map a plotting function into each facet.
entries.call:
grid = sns.FacetGrid(df, col="walk", hue="walk", palette="tab20c",
                     col_wrap=4, height=1.5)

entries.title: Plotting a diagonal correlation matrix
entries.label: heatmap
entries.role: Encode a rectangular matrix as colour, with annotation and masking controls.
entries.call:
sns.heatmap(corr, mask=mask, cmap=cmap, vmax=.3, center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=.5, cbar_kws={"shrink": .5})

entries.title: Scatterplot with marginal ticks
entries.label: JointGrid
entries.role: Combine a bivariate view with marginal views on the same figure.
entries.call: g = sns.JointGrid(data=mpg, x="mpg", y="acceleration", space=0, ratio=17)

entries.title: Multiple bivariate KDE plots
entries.label: kdeplot
entries.role: Estimate a smooth density and compare distributions through hue or levels.
entries.call:
sns.kdeplot(
    data=iris.query("species != 'versicolor'"),
    x="sepal_width",
    y="sepal_length",
    hue="species",
    thresh=.1,
)

entries.title: Conditional kernel density estimate
entries.label: displot
entries.role: Figure-level distribution interface: switch among histogram, KDE, ECDF and rug views.
entries.call:
sns.displot(
    data=diamonds,
    x="carat", hue="cut",
    kind="kde", height=6,
    multiple="fill", clip=(0, None),
    palette="ch:rot=-.25,hue=1,light=.75",
)

entries.title: Facetted ECDF plots
entries.label: displot
entries.role: Figure-level distribution interface: switch among histogram, KDE, ECDF and rug views.
entries.call:
sns.displot(
    mpg,
    x="displacement", col="origin", hue="model_year",
    kind="ecdf", aspect=.75, linewidth=2, palette=cmap,
)

entries.title: Multiple linear regression
entries.label: lmplot
entries.role: Fit a regression model while retaining observations and faceting options.
entries.call:
g = sns.lmplot(
    data=penguins,
    x="bill_length_mm", y="bill_depth_mm", hue="species",
    height=5
)

entries.title: Paired density and scatterplot matrix
entries.label: PairGrid
entries.role: Compose different plots on diagonal and off-diagonal pairwise views.
entries.call: g = sns.PairGrid(df, diag_sharey=False)

entries.title: Paired categorical plots
entries.label: PairGrid
entries.role: Compose different plots on diagonal and off-diagonal pairwise views.
entries.call:
g = sns.PairGrid(titanic, y_vars="survived",
                 x_vars=["class", "sex", "who", "alone"],
                 height=5, aspect=.5)

entries.title: Dot plot with several variables
entries.label: PairGrid
entries.role: Compose different plots on diagonal and off-diagonal pairwise views.
entries.call:
g = sns.PairGrid(crashes.sort_values("total", ascending=False),
                 x_vars=crashes.columns[:-3], y_vars=["abbrev"],
                 height=10, aspect=.25)

entries.title: Color palette choices
entries.label: barplot
entries.role: Estimate a summary for each category and show uncertainty with error bars.
entries.call: sns.barplot(x=x, y=y1, hue=x, palette="rocket", ax=ax1)

entries.title: Different cubehelix palettes
entries.label: kdeplot
entries.role: Estimate a smooth density and compare distributions through hue or levels.
entries.call:
sns.kdeplot(
        x=x, y=y,
        cmap=cmap, fill=True,
        clip=(-5, 5), cut=10,
        thresh=0, levels=15,
        ax=ax,
    )

entries.title: Horizontal bar plots
entries.label: barplot
entries.role: Estimate a summary for each category and show uncertainty with error bars.
entries.call:
sns.barplot(x="total", y="abbrev", data=crashes,
            label="Total", color="b")

entries.title: Plotting a three-way ANOVA
entries.label: catplot
entries.role: Figure-level categorical interface with switchable plot kinds and facets.
entries.call:
g = sns.catplot(
    data=exercise, x="time", y="pulse", hue="kind", col="diet",
    capsize=.2, palette="YlGnBu_d", errorbar="se",
    kind="point", height=6, aspect=.75,
)

entries.title: FacetGrid with custom projection
entries.label: FacetGrid
entries.role: Build a grid of subsets and map a plotting function into each facet.
entries.call:
g = sns.FacetGrid(df, col="speed", hue="speed",
                  subplot_kws=dict(projection='polar'), height=4.5,
                  sharex=False, sharey=False, despine=False)

entries.title: Linear regression with marginal distributions
entries.label: jointplot
entries.role: Convenient joint-and-marginal view with a switchable bivariate kind.
entries.call:
g = sns.jointplot(x="total_bill", y="tip", data=tips,
                  kind="reg", truncate=False,
                  xlim=(0, 60), ylim=(0, 12),
                  color="m", height=7)

entries.title: Plotting model residuals
entries.label: residplot
entries.role: Inspect the pattern left around a fitted relationship.
entries.call: sns.residplot(x=x, y=y, lowess=True, color="g")

entries.title: Scatterplot with varying point sizes and hues
entries.label: relplot
entries.role: Figure-level relational interface: switch between relational kinds and facet them.
entries.call:
sns.relplot(x="horsepower", y="mpg", hue="origin", size="weight",
            sizes=(40, 400), alpha=.5, palette="muted",
            height=6, data=mpg)

entries.title: Scatterplot with categorical variables
entries.label: swarmplot
entries.role: Show individual observations while arranging points to reduce overlap.
entries.call: ax = sns.swarmplot(data=df, x="body_mass_g", y="sex", hue="species")

entries.title: Scatterplot Matrix
entries.label: pairplot
entries.role: Convenient pairwise relationship matrix using common Seaborn defaults.
entries.call: sns.pairplot(df, hue="species")

entries.title: Scatterplot with continuous hues and sizes
entries.label: relplot
entries.role: Figure-level relational interface: switch between relational kinds and facet them.
entries.call:
g = sns.relplot(

    x="distance", y="orbital_period",

)

entries.title: Horizontal, unfilled violinplots
entries.label: violinplot
entries.role: Combine a distribution shape with categorical comparison and inner summaries.
entries.call: sns.violinplot(seaice, x="Extent", y="Decade", orient="y", fill=False)

entries.title: Smooth kernel density with marginal histograms

entries.role: Combine a bivariate view with marginal views on the same figure.
entries.call: g = sns.JointGrid(data=df, x="body_mass_g", y="bill_depth_mm", space=0)

entries.title: Annotated heatmaps
entries.label: heatmap
entries.role: Encode a rectangular matrix as colour, with annotation and masking controls.
entries.call: sns.heatmap(flights, annot=True, fmt="d", linewidths=.5, ax=ax)

entries.title: Regression fit over a strip plot
entries.label: catplot
entries.role: Figure-level categorical interface with switchable plot kinds and facets.
entries.call:
sns.catplot(
    data=mpg, x="cylinders", y="acceleration", hue="weight",
    native_scale=True, zorder=1
)

entries.title: Discovering structure in heatmap data
entries.label: clustermap
entries.role: Combine a heatmap with hierarchical clustering and colour annotations.
entries.call:
g = sns.clustermap(df.corr(), center=0, cmap="vlag",
                   row_colors=network_colors, col_colors=network_colors,
                   dendrogram_ratio=(.1, .2),
                   cbar_pos=(.02, .32, .03, .2),
                   linewidths=.75, figsize=(12, 13))

entries.title: Trivariate histogram with two categorical variables
entries.label: displot
entries.role: Figure-level distribution interface: switch among histogram, KDE, ECDF and rug views.
entries.call:
sns.displot(
    data=diamonds, x="price", y="color", col="clarity",
    log_scale=(True, False), col_wrap=4, height=4, aspect=.7,
)

entries.title: Small multiple time series

)
